name: atlas hub
summary: Multi-layer trusted discovery and distribution of process applications and related product catalogues, with independently governed standalone catalogues, reusable components and public, internal or commercial offers. No runtime licensing.
next_action: Owner key ceremony for the atlas hub sample registry (atlas hub keygen, two offline backups checked with atlas hub fingerprint, publicKey in examples/hub/releases.json, secret ATLAS_HUB_SIGNING_KEY), first Pages publication and a Console import from a real installation; then rebase draft PR #1424 and finish verified installation finalization and restart recovery (#1422).

slices.title: Registry and trust contract
slices.note: Complete: ADR-0499 Accepted; signed v1 schema, positive/negative fixtures and offline Ed25519/SHA-256 verifier landed in PR #1402 and #1405. Offline verifications only; no registry transport or installs.

slices.title: Signed application bundle to installed solution
slices.note: Merged #1411, #1415, #1416, #1420 and #1423 implement signed Blueprint Registry v1 browsing and human-reviewed application-plus-catalogue import. atlas hub keygen/fingerprint/lock/build publishes the installable examples as ten themed, tagged, deterministic signed packages with an immutable release lock; every package installs, publishes and re-imports as a no-op against a live server, and the Console filters by tag. Public publication awaits the owner's signing key; installations may pin two registry keys for an uninterrupted rotation (ADR-0499 amendment b). Draft #1424 provides pending-only durable provenance, not complete installation. Server-verified finalization, partial-failure/restart tests and separately approved standalone-catalogue contracts remain open. Product name is atlas hub; BMP and Blueprint v1 wire IDs remain stable. Before installing, the preview now shows the application's architecture sketch, derived by the server from the verified package's process models, and draws each BPMN model read-only (ADR-0539). Follow-ups of ADR-0539, unowned: #1634 (link a sketch box to its BPMN element), #1635 (cache the sketch per digest, only once measured), #1636 (sketch on the public hub site, needs an ADR amendment), #1637 (compare the preview sketch with the first release's, depends on #1422).

slices.title: Managed updates and provenance
slices.note: Pin version and digest, preserve local edits, test conflict/rollback/failure behavior and provenance recovery.

slices.title: Federated and private hub sources
slices.note: Mock authenticated/private sources and provider-neutral entitlements; no payments or runtime licensing in core.
